status: unadopted; no native or implementation qualification

accounting.originalSource: charge transport before buffering; reject length overflow before full allocation
accounting.artifacts: charge every reference decoding occurrence including repeated identical artifacts; retained originals and shared immutable storage may share peak reservation only with proven custody
accounting.graph: charge every visited node, reference edge and repeated occurrence; visited caching cannot erase performed work
accounting.sorting: charge comparisons and compared UTF-8 bytes; no uncharged quadratic uniqueness scans
accounting.hashing: charge actual input bytes for every hash and custody comparison
accounting.failures: retain bounded diagnostics; no accepted partial binding or incomplete coverage
accounting.deadline: minimum of this stage cap and enclosing operation deadline; active work containment required before capacity release

scope: Pure original binding/artifact parsing and semantic correspondence. PostgreSQL catalog collection and Weft compile/emission limits remain separately enforced; neither receives an unlimited allowance through this profile.
